description: List available one-on-one session slots for a date range and attendee timezone. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

rangeEnd.description: End of the time range to list slots for (ISO 8601).

rangeStart.description: Start of the time range to list slots for (ISO 8601).

sessionId.description: One-to-one session product ID, from a Nas.com product listing.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example Asia/Singapore.

name: list_session_slots
title: List Session Slots
